stories.title: Dry for one day
stories.summary: Our weekend leaves us dry for Saturday before rain returns on Sunday afternoon.

stories.title: 2 American Airlines jets clip wings on tarmac of Reagan Airport
stories.summary: There were no injuries when the wingtips of two American Airlines jets made contact Friday evening on the tarmac of Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport outside Washington, D.C.

stories.title: Metro Detroiters flock to stores for Black Friday shopping: "It's a lot of fun"
stories.summary: Before sunrise on Black Friday, shoppers bundled up and lined up outside Twelve Oaks Mall in Novi, eager to score holiday deals and kick off one of the year's busiest shopping days.

stories.title: Man fatally shot during altercation in Birmingham, Michigan; suspect in custody
stories.summary: Police in Birmingham, Michigan, say they are investigating a shooting that left a 20-year-old Inkster man dead on Friday morning.

stories.title: Trev Alberts' attorney calls for firing of incoming University of Michigan president
stories.summary: An attorney representing Trev Alberts is calling for the University of Michigan Board of Regents to fire incoming President C. Cybele Raver, claiming "gross negligence in making the most reckless, indefensible decision in college sports history."

stories.title: John Gibson records 29th career shutout as Red Wings beat Blue Jackets 2-0
stories.summary: J.T. Compher and Alex DeBrincat scored, and John Gibson made 18 saves for his 29th career shutout as the Detroit Red Wings beat Columbus 2-0 Friday, sending the Blue Jackets to their fifth consecutive home loss.

stories.title: Iowa lead detonation testing results expected soon, EPA says
stories.summary: The EPA conducted sampling at more than 130 structures in Iowa, including homes, schools, daycare centers and churches.

stories.title: Organizers prepare for Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade after postponement
stories.summary: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed to Saturday, and now organizers are preparing for one of the biggest events in New York City.

stories.title: Winter Market Weekend kicks off at Michigan Central
stories.summary: Many people will be heading to Michigan Central for Winter Market Weekend. It features up to 40 local markets and small businesses.
